tier.description: `base`: weak elemental rune — round-card pool, always in the shop, forge fuel. `advanced`: forged in the Stronghold oven or granted by a commander.

icon.description: atlas id for HUD and world badges (`item-*`)

mods.description: stat multipliers for every mech of the equipped pack

debuffImmune.description: pack-wide immunity to tower-destruction debuffs for the battle

grantsShieldHp.description: grants every mech in the pack a shield pool equal to its max HP

priority.description: tie-break among same-size matches, higher wins (default 1)

forge.description: Forge recipe producing this rune: the exact multiset of rune ids the oven must hold. No two recipes may share the same ingredients.

forgeCost.description: Supply the Stronghold charges to fire the oven for this rune, on top of the ingredients. Omit = free. Only advanced (forged) runes have one.

cardCost.description: supply price as a between-round card (default 50)
